div.div: Every query command runs off the UI thread (spawn_blocking) against the window’s store; an import never blocks readers. query_page, query_timeline, query_chart and source_context are not cancelled; the UI ignores stale replies (seq / generation). run_query_stream keys jobs by (window, queryId), at most 8 per window; the job is removed when it ends.
